Welcome to NEON SYNC—an overclocked visualization of federated learning teams competing in a futuristic grand prix. Watch accuracy, convergence speed, and robustness metrics spike and crash as bandwidth changes and adversarial challenges hit.

In this race, competitors train without sharing raw data—only model updates. Can they sync fast enough to stay ahead?
